title: 变化与转折

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：I used to [old habit/belief], but now I [new behavior/perspective].
sentenceFrames.usage: 讲个人变化。*used to* 是口语中最常用的表达"过去曾经"的方式。
sentenceFrames.example: I used to think being busy meant being important. But now I realize that being busy just means... being busy. It has nothing to do with doing meaningful work.
substitutions: I used to **hate exercising**, but now I _____.
I used to **be afraid of speaking up in meetings**, but now I _____.
I used to **think success meant _____,** but now I think _____.
你的真实变化：I used to _____, but now I _____.

sentenceFrames.usage: 点出改变的催化剂——那一件事或那个瞬间。
sentenceFrames.example: Everything changed when my manager said to me, "You're the quietest person in the room, but you have the best ideas. Why don't you share them?" That hit me hard.
substitutions: Everything changed when **I read this one book that said _____.
Everything changed when **I met someone who _____.
Everything changed when **I failed at _____ and realized _____.
你人生的转折点：Everything changed when _____.

sentenceFrames.usage: 事后反思——"当时不觉得，现在回头看才明白"。
sentenceFrames.example: Looking back, I realize that getting fired from that job was the best thing that ever happened to me. It forced me to figure out what I actually wanted.
substitutions: Looking back, I realize **that decision I was so worried about didn't matter that much.
Looking back, I realize **my parents were right about _____.
Looking back, I realize **the hardest periods in my life were also the ones where I grew the most.
你的反思：Looking back, I realize _____.
